eligibility_rules.required_subjects: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Computer Science
eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: NUST Entry Test (NET-1, NET-2, NET-3, NET-4), ACT / SAT Subject
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 60% aggregate in HSSC (Pre-Engineering / ICS) or A-Level equivalent with Mathematics & Physics.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Meeting minimum eligibility does NOT guarantee admission. Admission is highly competitive based on NET merit aggregate (75% NET + 25% HSSC/Matric).

eligibility_rules.required_subjects: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry or Computer Studies
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 60% aggregate marks in F.Sc Pre-Engineering / Computer Science or equivalent British GCE A-Levels.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Selection is merit-driven based on official closing cutoff scores published annually by NUST.

eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: SAT-I (Score >= 1300 recommended) or LUMS Common Admission Test (LCAT)
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 70% in Matric/O-Level and F.Sc/A-Levels with strong quantitative preparation.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Admission is holistic, evaluating academic records, standardized test scores, extracurriculars, personal statement, and recommendation letters.

eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: FAST National University Admission Test (NU Test) or NTS-NAT
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: At least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) with Mathematics or equivalent examination.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Merit is determined primarily by NU Test performance; top campuses (Islamabad and Lahore) typically close above 68% combined aggregate.

eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: AKU Medical College Admission Test & PMDC MDCAT
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 65% in HSSC Pre-Medical or equivalent British A-Level (with Biology & Chemistry).
eligibility_rules.caveat: Shortlisted candidates must clear rigorous multiple mini-interviews (MMI) and satisfy PMDC statutory quotas.

eligibility_rules.required_subjects: Any discipline with Mathematics or Quantitative Aptitude
eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: IBA Aptitude Test or SAT-I (Math >= 600, EBRW >= 600)
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 65% in HSSC or minimum grades B-B-C in British A-Levels.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Candidates must achieve minimum cutoff marks in both English and Mathematics test sections independently.

eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: NUST Entry Test (NET Engineering), SAT Subject
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 60% aggregate marks in F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) or equivalent British A-Levels with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only based on published rules. Final admission depends on competitive merit position and available seats.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 70% in Matriculation / O-Levels (at least 8 subjects) and at least 3 principal subjects in British A-Levels (grades BBC or better) or equivalent F.Sc/FA.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only based on published criteria. LUMS evaluates holistic profiles including personal statement, extracurriculars, and admissions test score.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Minimum 60% aggregate marks in HSSC (Pre-Engineering or ICS with Mathematics & Physics) or equivalent British A-Level examination.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only based on published rules. Admission is competitive and based on combined GIKI entrance test and academic score.

eligibility_rules.accepted_entry_tests: NU Admission Test, NTS NAT-IE, SAT
eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: At least 50% marks in Intermediate (HSSC) Pre-Engineering or ICS with Mathematics, or equivalent British A-Level examination.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only based on published rules. Campus allocation and merit list depends on competitive entrance test performance.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: At least 60% marks in F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) or equivalent British A-Levels, with qualifying score in official ECAT examination.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only based on published rules. Final admission determined strictly by UET aggregate merit formula.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Standard conditional offer requires A*AA at British A-Level with A* in Mathematics, Further Mathematics or Computer Science, plus competitive score in the Oxford MAT and collegiate interview.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only. Oxford admissions involve shortlisting, college interview performance, MAT test scores, and UCAS personal reference.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Typical offer is A*A*A at British A-Level including Mathematics and Physics, plus college interview and qualifying score on the ESAT assessment.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only. Cambridge college admission decisions consider ESAT, interview, written assessment, and teacher recommendation.

eligibility_rules.rule_explanation: Recognized Higher Education Entrance Qualification (German Abitur or validated international secondary equivalence) evaluated via TUM two-stage aptitude assessment.
eligibility_rules.caveat: Guidance only. Applicants who do not reach direct admission point threshold must participate in a 20-minute assessment interview.
